assumption: Independent paired process log-ratios support a Student-t interval; six process pairs give five degrees of freedom. Intervals are per cell, not a simultaneous family-wise guarantee.
scope: Conditional statistical outcomes for complete module latency only; correctness gates must already be satisfied. Host intervals exclude untimed TP barriers. No aggregate hides a failed or incomplete cell.
continuous_clock_admission: This analyzer does not parse the continuous telemetry log. Both GPUs'4752 MHz samples must be independently qualified across every measured interval before any performance retention claim.
